    The relations of a linearization, spanned by words of a closed set of paths #

    The kernel of the presentation kQ_P → k(P) is generated by the zero paths and by the differences of two paths with the same value. Let Z be a set of nonempty directed paths of Q_P which is closed under extension, contains the zero paths, and contains every path whose value is also the value of a different path (RelPaths). The words of Z span a two-sided ideal, so the kernel lies in their span (ker_linPres_le_of). ker_linPres_le is the case of the zero paths of a ray category without contours.

    Prop

    A set of nonempty directed paths of Q_P, closed under extension, containing the zero paths and every path that shares its value with a different path.

    • ne_nil (l : List (quiver P).A) : l ∈ Z → l ≠ []
    • path (l : List (quiver P).A) : l ∈ Z → ∃ (x : (quiver P).V) (y : (quiver P).V), FinQuiver.PathFrom x l y
    • ext_right (l : List (quiver P).A) : l ∈ Z → ∀ (l' : List (quiver P).A) (x z : P), FinQuiver.PathFrom x (l ++ l') z → l ++ l' ∈ Z
    • ext_left (l : List (quiver P).A) : l ∈ Z → ∀ (l' : List (quiver P).A) (x z : P), FinQuiver.PathFrom x (l' ++ l) z → l' ++ l ∈ Z
    • zero : ZeroPaths P ⊆ Z
    • contour (l l' : List (quiver P).A) (x y : P) (h : FinQuiver.PathFrom x l y) (h' : FinQuiver.PathFrom x l' y) : pathMor l x y h = pathMor l' x y h' → l ≠ l' → l ∈ Z
